summary.text: Billie Butler is a Democratic state representative for New Hampshire House of Representatives Strafford 12 who took office in July 2025 after a special election and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. Butler is an artist and has worked as a performing artist and gig worker.

paragraphs.text: Butler advanced from the special Democratic primary for Strafford 12 on May 6, 2025, and defeated Ken Hilton in the special general election on June 24, 2025, succeeding Gerri Cannon.
On September 8, 2026, Butler was among the four Democrats who advanced from the Democratic primary for Strafford 12, defeating incumbent John Joseph Stone.
